# subnets

Subnets divide a VPC into address ranges that instances attach to.

## GET /v1/subnets

Operation `subnet_list`.

`GET /v1/subnets?vpc=<uuid>`. Flat subnet list. Paginated per convention 3: `limit` (default 50, capped at 500), `page_token`, and `sort_by`. Only `id_ascending` is accepted, because `subnet/in_vpc/` is keyed by the subnet id.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `vpc` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to subnets in a given VPC. Required at AP-2g. |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ResultsPage_for_Subnet](schemas.md#resultspage_for_subnet)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## POST /v1/subnets

Operation `subnet_create`.

`POST /v1/subnets?vpc=<uuid>`. Create a subnet inside the named VPC. The VPC's owning tenant+project is resolved from the row; `?vpc=<uuid>` is the only required selector. With SSH on, the default, the subnet takes one of the tenant's relay slots, `403` when none is free.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `vpc` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to subnets in a given VPC. Required at AP-2g. |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [NewSubnet](schemas.md#newsubnet)

Responses:

- `201`: successful creation, `application/json`: [Subnet](schemas.md#subnet)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/subnets/{subnet_id}

Operation `subnet_delete`.

`DELETE /v1/subnets/{subnet_id}`. Refused with 409 while instances have NICs on the subnet, or while it holds a NAT gateway zone that other subnets egress through. Otherwise answers `202` with the subnet as it was; its platform zones are taken down and it is gone, and reads answer `404`, once that finishes.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `subnet_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Responses:

- `202`: successfully enqueued operation, `application/json`: [Subnet](schemas.md#subnet)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## PATCH /v1/subnets/{subnet_id}

Operation `subnet_update`.

Rename or re-describe a subnet, or turn its SSH relay on or off. Blocks cannot change. `409` when the name is already used in the VPC. Turning SSH on takes one of the tenant's relay slots, `403` when none is free. Turning it off is allowed while the account may not provision.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `subnet_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SubnetUpdate](schemas.md#subnetupdate)

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [Subnet](schemas.md#subnet)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## PUT /v1/subnets/{subnet_id}/route-table

Operation `subnet_route_table_update`.

Point a subnet at a route table in its VPC. The table decides which routes a NIC on the subnet gets, and so whether the subnet has an internet egress path. `409` for a table in another VPC.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `subnet_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |

Request body (required): `application/json`: [SubnetRouteTableBody](schemas.md#subnetroutetablebody)

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [Subnet](schemas.md#subnet)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
